feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 30 August 2026 8:39am
items.description:
##Today##

A dry start with bright or sunny intervals, ahead of showers or longer spells of rain in the afternoon, the risk of which gradually diminishes through the evening.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-6


##Wind Speed##

13


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

S or SW, veering W or NW overnight, 10-15, occasionally 20 in the south of the area at first, and in the west of the area overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers or rain. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

Isolated showers at first, but soon becoming mostly dry with sunny intervals developing. Feeling breezy for a time.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-2


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

NW or W 10-20, imminently increasing 20-25 for a time, then backing SW 10-15 later. Then increasing 20-25 again late in the night.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, possibly moderate in showers. Patchy hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds at times.


##Tuesday, 1 September 2026##

Sunny intervals and only isolated showers during the daytime, then becoming cloudy with outbreaks of rain arriving late evening and overnight. Feeling breezy for a time.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-5, mainly later.


##Wind Speed##

19


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW, backing S later, 15-20, perhaps locally 25 at first, increasing S 20-30 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers or rain. Hill fog later.


##Comments##

Strong winds at times.


##Wednesday, 2 September 2026##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain and drizzle at first, clearing to isolated showers and some bright or sunny intervals. Feeling particularly windy at times.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 19°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0.5-3


##Wind Speed##

23


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

S or SW 20-25, occasionally 30 at times.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain and drizzle. Hill fog at first.


##Comments##

Strong winds.


##Thursday, 3 September 2026##

Sunny intervals and isolated showers. Feeling particularly windy at times.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 19°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-2


##Wind Speed##

23

W


##Wind##

W or SW 20-25, occasionally 30 at times.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Comments##
